samples.question: Two columns of square slots, left and right.  Every slot carries a small coloured tab: cyan, magenta, or amber.  Each column uses all three tab colours once, but the right column's top-to-bottom order differs from the left.  A left slot and a right slot are PARTNERS when they share the same tab colour.  Every slot also holds a marker that is either a solid dark square or a hollow square.  A pair is TRUE when the two partner slots (same tab colour) hold the same marker kind.  How many true partners are there: zero, one, two, or three?
